exact: modulation by symbiont of host receptor-mediated endocytosis
modulation of host receptor-mediated endocytosis by symbiont
regulation by symbiont of host receptor-mediated endocytosis

definition: A process in which a symbiont initiates, promotes, or enhances host receptor-mediated endocytosis, the uptake of external materials by cells, utilizing receptors to ensure specificity of transport. The host is defined as the larger of the organisms involved in a symbiotic interaction.
label: symbiont-mediated perturbation of host receptor-mediated endocytosis
